blends.name: Portage is Home Standard to Limited Blend
blends.desc: To attempt this blend you need 5 like NFTs of this design, one rarity lower. There is a 66.6% chance of success and a 33.3% chance of failure. Failure will result in a new pack of 4 NFTs. Three of those NFTs are guaranteed to be of the same design and rarity submitted for blending. The last NFT has a 3% chance of being two levels higher than submitted for blending (i.e. 5 standard NFTs will either result in 1 exclusive, or a pack of 4 NFTs; 3 of which will be standard and 1 of which will be standard or rare). The chance at two rarity levels higher does not apply to the Ultra Rare blend.
